title: CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Council action of May 24, 2021, Council file No.…
text:
[Council File 21-0182]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Council action of May 24, 2021, Council file No. 21-0182, to add two young people appointed by the Los Angeles City/County Native American Indian Commission to the composition of the Olivia E. Mitchell Youth Council.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Rodriguez - Padilla):
AMEND the Council Action of May 24, 2021, relative to the establishment of the Olivia Mitchell Youth Council (CF 21-0182) to add two young people to the composition of the Olivia E. Mitchell Youth Council to be appointed by the Los Angeles City/County Native American Indian Commission.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
